style.name: Cybercore
style.description: Cybercore is a loose contemporary aesthetic built around technological imagery, machine-like graphics, and digital intensity. Chrome forms, sharp geometry, and interface fragments can give an experience the feeling of a speculative computer system.

fonts.heading: Space Grotesk
fonts.rationale: Angular-feeling display shapes and a monospaced supporting face suggest technical instrumentation.

tips: Use metadata to reinforce real information.
Build a clear structure beneath the visual noise.
Limit chrome to a few focal elements.
avoid: Confusing decorative panels with interactive controls.

recipe.composition: Use modular terminal panels and technical typography; group dense information with consistent alignment.
